top_improvements.title: Use modkit dmr's Beta-Binomial likelihood-ratio as a fast genome-wide PRE-FILTER before the expensive O(N^3) UPGMA + 999-perm PERMANOVA
top_improvements.rationale: ISM's structural engine (cores 1-3) is heavy: UPGMA is O(N^3) per region, PERMANOVA runs 999 label permutations. modkit dmr is a fast count-based rate-difference test overlapping ISM's β-rate/Δβ layer. Running modkit dmr genome-wide first to triage candidate regions, then reserving the structural test for regions passing a rate-difference or MHL-coordination screen, cuts compute without changing conclusions — modkit dmr cannot SUBSTITUTE for cores 1-3 (it collapses reads to per-position counts) but is an excellent cheap gate. PRECEDENT: scripts 54-56 already wire modkit into a single-sample pilot, so the extraction plumbing exists.
top_improvements.effort: Low-Medium — modkit is a single Rust binary (not yet installed: not on PATH, no ~/.cargo); wire `modkit dmr`/`extract` as an upstream triage step. The 54-56 pilot is the template.

top_improvements.title: Add Cohen's h (arcsine) as a saturation-robust companion to Cohen's d on Δβ, and keep 5mC/5hmC distinct via Dirichlet-Multinomial instead of max-collapse
top_improvements.rationale: Two coupled effect-size fixes. (a) Cohen's d on raw β is unstable at saturating coverage — targeted cancer loci often hit near-100% methylation in both groups where raw β-difference compresses; Cohen's h (arcsine variance-stabilized) is robust and is modkit dmr's native effect size. (b) ISM MAX-collapses 5mC+5hmC into 'any-modification' (cis_asm_core.py:31-32) — VERIFIED this exact double-count caused the prior buggy BRCA2 Δβ=-0.054 artifact (MSA Level-1 stacking, per project memory). A Dirichlet-Multinomial multi-state model keeps channels separate. ALREADY PILOTED: script 55 explicitly re-tests with 5mC/5hmC SEPARATED on modkit continuous beta, asking whether a 5hmC subpopulation is hidden by max-collapse — validation-in-progress, not a new idea; the synthesis must report it as such.

top_improvements.title: Add an imprinting/germline-ICR POSITIVE control and reframe ASM as cis/trans-regulatory (not a variant filter), borrowing the germline benchmarks of pycoMeth/cvlr/NanoMethPhase
top_improvements.rationale: Every read-level ASM/clustering competitor (cvlr, pycoMeth, NanoMethPhase, DAMEfinder) is VALIDATED on germline imprinting/parent-of-origin (GIAB trio, NA12878). ISM has NO known-truth positive control — only its HP-shuffle null. Running ISM on a canonical imprinted ICR (where the answer is established) gives a positive control that the structural engine detects real ASM when it exists, strengthening the somatic-negative claims by contrast. SECOND: the digest repeatedly flags ISM imports a germline confound if it borrows any segmentation/test without the normal-anchored cis-control — so the paper framing is: ISM's normal-anchored cis-test (d_somatic/d_cis/d_drift) is the somatic-causality control these germline tools STRUCTURALLY LACK. Defensive (protects novelty) and additive (positive control) at once.
top_improvements.effort: Low-Medium — pick a canonical imprinted locus (H19/IGF2, SNRPN), run existing ISM cores, confirm strong HP-axis Δβ + PERMANOVA structure. No code change, a control experiment.

novelty_defensible: THE NARROW COMBINATION ISM UNIQUELY OWNS (digest correctly isolates it): an explicit N×N read↔read DISTANCE matrix (cores 1-2, NHD/UPGMA/silhouette) + a non-parametric PERMANOVA STRUCTURE test (core 3, 999 label-permutations on that matrix) applied to SOMATIC cancer haplotype groups with a NORMAL-ANCHORED cis-test (core 6, d_somatic/d_cis/d_drift three-way + copy-partition). No surveyed tool has this stack. VERIFIED against closest competitors: (a) cvlr is the ONLY other phasing-free ONT read clusterer, but uses generative Bernoulli-mixture/EM (soft membership, NO structure significance test) and is germline-validated only — never builds a read-read distance matrix or runs PERMANOVA; (b) modkit dmr/DSS/all WGBS callers collapse reads to per-position counts and test BETWEEN-GROUP MEAN rate (β-rate axis, NOT between-molecule structure); (c) MHB/MHL is the literal TRANSPOSE — within-read CpG-CpG coupling (column axis), provably blind to read partition (high MHL is compatible with both 1 and 2 read clusters); (d) WSH/disorder family (PDR/epipolymorphism/NME/FDRP) measures within-read RANDOMNESS, the opposite construct from between-molecule ORGANIZATION.

PERMANOVA-AS-'STRUCTURE-NOT-DISORDER' is genuinely distinctive: the survey establishes the entire disorder family (entropy, PDR, epipolymorphism, NME, FDRP/qFDRP) answers 'how random is methylation within a molecule' while ISM cores 1-3 answer 'do molecules partition into structurally-separated subpopulations.' ISM deliberately RE-IMPLEMENTS the disorder metrics (VERIFIED PerCpgAsm.hpp:9,33-34, source-cited to CPEL/methclone/Metheor) purely as contrast baseline — owning both axes in one engine and explicitly framing structure vs disorder is defensible.
